# Precedence Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PrecedenceTenure`](gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PrecedenceTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified, time-scoped fact that one norm took precedence over another within a normative system over an interval — 'Tier 2 overrode X until v3.5' made sayable. The [`StandpointTenure`](gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) idiom ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)): carries its interval via [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) (temporal module); a withdrawn precedence is kept with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false, never deleted. Use only when adoption / revision of the precedence is itself worth modelling; the common case is flat [`gmeow:overrides`](../properties/gmeow-overrides.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PrecedenceTenure`](gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use the reified form when the precedence held over an interval — its adoption, revision, or withdrawal — is itself the fact of interest, e.g. 'Tier 2 overrode X until v3.5'.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the ordinary case (flat [`gmeow:overrides`](../properties/gmeow-overrides.md) carries pairwise precedence more cheaply) and avoid deleting a withdrawn precedence — keep it with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Mint the tenure, name the prevailing and yielding norms with gmeow:precedenceHigher/precedenceLower, scope it with [`gmeow:precedenceScope`](../properties/gmeow-precedenceScope.md), and carry its interval via the inherited [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md).

### Examples

- ex:pt1 a [`gmeow:PrecedenceTenure`](gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md); [`gmeow:precedenceHigher`](../properties/gmeow-precedenceHigher.md) ex:tier2; [`gmeow:precedenceLower`](../properties/gmeow-precedenceLower.md) ex:xN; [`gmeow:precedenceScope`](../properties/gmeow-precedenceScope.md) ex:gdpr.
